question: When does the league publish the next weekly injury report, and can the capture run inside that window every week?
why_it_matters: A delta needs two dated reads of the same week. Without a fixed publication time the capture may always read the same state and never see a change.
what_we_have: A scheduled capture that runs twice a day and writes a dated, hashed snapshot every time it reads.
what_is_missing: A measured publication time per week and the league's own retention policy.
how_to_resolve: Record the first moment each week's report changes on nfl.com across a full season and publish the distribution.

question: Which club is the source of truth for depth when the chart is a month old?
why_it_matters: Depth decides the replacement string. A stale chart silently changes the deficiency the model sees.
what_we_have: Each captured depth row carries the club's own source URL, the capture time and the chart's own as-of text when the club prints one.
what_is_missing: The clubs' publication cadence for depth charts and whether they revise them without changing the as-of text.
how_to_resolve: Capture the depth charts daily for a month and publish how often the content actually changes.

question: Do the clubs publish their own inactive lists, and are they identical to the Game Book's Not Active list?
why_it_matters: Two official lists for the same fact either agree or one is wrong; the difference is a data-quality signal.
what_we_have: The official Game Book Not Active list, captured.
what_is_missing: The club-published inactive lists for the same games.
how_to_resolve: Capture both for one week and publish the row-level difference.

question: How many weeks of dated captures are needed before a designation may be used as a model feature?
why_it_matters: The brief requires the reliability of a designation to be measured before it is used; that needs a sample, not an opinion.
what_we_have: The machinery, and the first dated captures.
what_is_missing: A sample size rule agreed in advance (the analogue of the 300-bet rule already used for betting samples).
how_to_resolve: Freeze the rule before the season's captures accumulate, in the same way a strategy is pre-registered.

question: Should the depth-chart route be the club pages only, or should official playing time take precedence where both exist?
why_it_matters: Route (a) is club depth charts; route (b) is snap counts. The brief requires the route to be resolved before the deficiency feature is built.
what_we_have: Route (a) captured for the clubs whose charts are machine-readable.
what_is_missing: An official playing-time source that can be joined to the chart without using an unattributed mirror.
how_to_resolve: Compare the chart order with the official Game Book starting line-up for the same games and publish the disagreement rate.
